fact_text: Reported State Bank reserves cover only the central bank's own holdings; commercial banks' foreign-exchange reserves are held separately and are not included.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'State Bank Reserves Reach All-Time High: $21.4 Billion (What It Means) Shafy Weekly.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: State Bank reportedly met its June 2026 reserve target of about $18 billion on time, which the presenter cites as evidence it is hitting its reserve goals.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'State Bank Reserves Reach All-Time High: $21.4 Billion (What It Means) Shafy Weekly.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Rising oil prices feed into inflation, and the presenter argues that this makes a cut in the policy rate unlikely, with some analysts even floating a hike.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'State Bank Reserves Reach All-Time High: $21.4 Billion (What It Means) Shafy Weekly.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Under the 2026 auto policy, locally made hybrids up to 1,800cc paid 8.5% sales tax, larger hybrids paid 12.75%, and other vehicles paid 25%.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'State Bank Reserves Reach All-Time High: $21.4 Billion (What It Means) Shafy Weekly.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When the 2026 auto policy expired on 30 June, hybrids fell into the 25% sales-tax bracket, creating confusion over the applicable rate and hurting buyer clarity.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'State Bank Reserves Reach All-Time High: $21.4 Billion (What It Means) Shafy Weekly.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The Asaan Tax Scheme lets small traders with turnover up to PKR 200 million pay 1% of turnover as tax, subject to a PKR 25,000 minimum annual tax.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'State Bank Reserves Reach All-Time High: $21.4 Billion (What It Means) Shafy Weekly.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Many Pakistani traders believe that registering with the tax authority means being taxed indefinitely; the tax authority and trader associations now visit shops jointly to correct this perception.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'State Bank Reserves Reach All-Time High: $21.4 Billion (What It Means) Shafy Weekly.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A fuel subsidy that dealers must fund at the pump fails when the reimbursement path is unclear, because dealers will not absorb a per-litre loss without knowing who repays them.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'State Bank Reserves Reach All-Time High: $21.4 Billion (What It Means) Shafy Weekly.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan's crude supply agreement with Oman was signed as an intergovernmental deal in 2018, naming OQ Trading for Oman and PSO for Pakistan, and stalled over terms in 2021.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'State Bank Reserves Reach All-Time High: $21.4 Billion (What It Means) Shafy Weekly.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Oman lies directly across the sea from Pakistan with no intervening country, so its crude avoids the Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea chokepoints that the presenter sees as the main supply risks.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'State Bank Reserves Reach All-Time High: $21.4 Billion (What It Means) Shafy Weekly.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan is also weighing crude from Fujairah in the UAE, which sits on the Oman coast and lies outside the Strait of Hormuz, as well as from Libya, the US, West Africa, Nigeria and Kazakhstan.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'State Bank Reserves Reach All-Time High: $21.4 Billion (What It Means) Shafy Weekly.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: If a damaged Saudi East-West pipeline is not restored, global oil supply could fall by roughly 4 to 5%, and the pressure on remaining suppliers pushes prices up.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'State Bank Reserves Reach All-Time High: $21.4 Billion (What It Means) Shafy Weekly.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Oil is Pakistan's largest import bill, so reducing oil imports through diversified supply or faster EV adoption would materially help the external position.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'State Bank Reserves Reach All-Time High: $21.4 Billion (What It Means) Shafy Weekly.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The KSE-100 is recomposed twice a year; the review covering March to August 2026 replaced four companies, effective 1 October.
